name: 奉仕記録の承認詳細
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0021 奉仕記録の承認詳細. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source is authoritative for glyph geometry, optical/stroke weight, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls. Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized content/layout guide; do not copy omitted/rough controls or mint pending badge. Image3 approved bus is white surface/depth style only.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact logical640px-wide white rounded detail panel (about494–530px tall), fine neutral border and soft subtle shadow. Header neutral circular avatar 「山」, modest bold14/24 「山田 太郎」 and small source-style downward triangle for person selector. Right small WHITE neutral/amber-outline status 「確認待ち」 with amber text #9A6B12; pending meaning must not look like green approved state.
White neutral-outline date field labelled 「担当日」 value 「10月18日（日）」. Two aligned white input fields labelled 「開始」「終了」 with values 「09:00」「12:00」. Restore source SMALL EMPTY square checkbox and label 「奉仕は継続中」 beside or immediately below end field, unchecked; do not invent checkmarks or active state. Place field label 「担当場所」 value 「受付・ライトハウス」. Source date/time/place fields have NO visible utility icons/carets, so do not add any there.
Inset neutral divider. Expanded break section header 「休憩 食事休憩30分」, with small UPWARD source-style chevron at right. Wider white input labelled 「種類」 value 「食事休憩」, narrower white input labelled 「時間」 value 「30分」, and a SMALL slate trash glyph at far right: source-like lid/handle/tapered body with tiny white vertical slots, about12logicalpx, not oversized bucket. Restore source wider-type/narrow-duration proportions instead of mock equal split. Under these fields forest-green text links 「休憩を追加」「時刻を設定」. Inset divider. Footer 「奉仕時間 2時間30分」 and right forest-green 「編集」 action. Keep saved Japanese values and correct arithmetic09:00–12:00 minus30min=2h30min.
Meiryo14/24regular body,12/16regular metadata, restrained bold person label only, tracking0, clean wrapping and baselines. Preserve every stated field/value/control. No invented approval button: source Approve action lies OUTSIDE this component's crop, and mock has no such action. No wages, balances, comments, app backdrop or extra metrics. Purple source links adapt to #1F6444 forest green; utility glyphs #526173 slate; actual pending state uses coherent amber supported by text. All surfaces white, no mint/gray wash, random icon colors, glow or plastic gloss. Source fine controls outrank mock omissions. Static raster candidate only, no actual approval/timesheet behavior claimed.
reviewNotes: 原画優先で本人選択三角/未選択継続中箱/展開上シェブロン/小さい溝付き削除/種類大・時間小を復元。保存日本語/担当日/09:00–12:00/休憩30分/合計2時間30分/編集を保持。確認待ちは意味に合う琥珀と白、紫リンクは森林緑、他スレート。原画範囲外の承認ボタンは追加なし。実画像で全内容/切れなし確認。実承認/権限/フォント同定は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
